name: The Fool's First Answer
summary: Delphine's Thread of Fate: the Discovery.

stages.journal: Delphine needs an answer to one of the Fool's riddles. An Act II chapter will bring it to her.
stages.hint: Keep Delphine with the party, or at camp, and rest once the chapter is done.

waits.text: Delphine will want a word at camp once that chapter is behind us.

stages.journal: In the Crimson Monastery Delphine solved one of the Fool's riddles out loud, and he stopped laughing.
